text: On July 14, 2017 the Office of the City Solicitor sent an invitation on behalf of the City Manager to provide investigative and legal services to law firms with experience in complex workplace and forensic investigations, particularly in relation to complicated development and real estate transactions and financial management issues, as well as experience in working with municipalities and knowledge of municipal governance issues. On November 21, 2017 the Investigators from Torys attended at the Toronto Parking Authority Board meeting and provided a progress update of the Investigation. A further update on the progress of the Investigation is being provided at this time.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions in closed session in issuing instructions to staff. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 26, 2018) from the City Solicitor, remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege and relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals, including municipal or local board employees. 3. Agreed to report to City Council on the actions the Board has taken so far on this matter.
